WITH high_fidelity_mesh AS (
    SELECT 
        s.zoneref AS site_code,
        COUNT(*) AS total_mesh_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN sm.geomdeltamm < 0.5 AND sm.facetresmm < 1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_fidelity_mesh_count,
        AVG(sm.geomdeltamm) AS avg_geometric_accuracy,
        AVG(sm.facetresmm) AS avg_resolution_mm,
        -- Assuming Mesh Quality is derived from uvmapqual
        ARRAY_AGG(sm.uvmapqual) AS mesh_quality
    FROM 
        scanmesh AS sm
    JOIN 
        sites AS s ON sm.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
    GROUP BY 
        s.zoneref
)
SELECT 
    hfm.site_code,
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    hfm.total_mesh_count,
    hfm.high_fidelity_mesh_count,
    (hfm.high_fidelity_mesh_count * 100.0 / hfm.total_mesh_count) AS proportion_high_fidelity,
    hfm.avg_geometric_accuracy,
    hfm.avg_resolution_mm,
    hfm.mesh_quality
FROM 
    high_fidelity_mesh AS hfm
JOIN 
    sites AS s ON hfm.site_code = s.zoneregistry
ORDER BY 
    proportion_high_fidelity DESC;

The data is presented in descending order of the proportion of high-fidelity meshes.

**Note:** The High Fidelity Mesh standard is defined as a mesh with MCR > 5.0, FacetResMm  1.0, and GeomDeltaMm  0.5. MCR

WITH high_fidelity_mesh AS (
    SELECT 
        s.zoneref AS site_code,
        COUNT(*) AS total_mesh_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN sm.geomdeltamm < 0.5 AND sm.facetresmm < 1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_fidelity_mesh_count,
        AVG(sm.geomdeltamm) AS avg_geometric_accuracy,
        AVG(sm.facetresmm) AS avg_resolution_mm,
        -- Assuming Mesh Quality is derived from uvmapqual
        ARRAY_AGG(sm.uvmapqual) AS mesh_quality
    FROM 
        scanmesh AS sm
    JOIN 
        sites AS s ON sm.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
    GROUP BY 
        s.zoneref
)
SELECT 
    hfm.site_code,
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    hfm.total_mesh_count,
    hfm.high_fidelity_mesh_count,
    (hfm.high_fidelity_mesh_count * 100.0 / hfm.total_mesh_count) AS proportion_high_fidelity,
    hfm.avg_geometric_accuracy,
    hfm.avg_resolution_mm,
    hfm.mesh_quality
FROM 
    high_fidelity_mesh AS hfm
JOIN 
    sites AS s ON hfm.site_code = s.zoneregistry
ORDER BY 
    proportion_high_fidelity DESC;
